decoderSummaries.name: wasm
decoderSummaries.limitation: process.heapUsed is a coarse Node heap observation, not native/WASM peak RSS attribution

limitations: Positioned-file reads measure the reader and local storage path; they are not HTTP or browser measurements.
Cold library mode creates a new archive reader per query; operating-system and remote CDN cache state are uncontrolled.
Warm mode primes the exact query, retaining both directory and compressed-payload library caches within their configured byte budgets.
